notes: Flag sets are hypotheses. RTTI (/GR) is confirmed by the retail binary; optimization/runtime/CPU flags still need empirical matching. clang_probe disables /GS so modern stack-cookie codegen does not contaminate comparisons with the VC6-era retail binary. VC6 /Z7 supplies COFF function-size metadata for matching; it is a measurement setting, not a claim about the original build.
